text_block_list.text: The final day of summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Summer comes to an end.
In two months, the Kikuka Sho will be upon us—)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...The victor is I.
And I shall etch it into history as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the autumn, and through the winter still.
Even if fiercer battles await us
upon an even greater stage.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
With this body alone, I shall show them hope
and lead the Rose Clan forward.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That is the true caliber of a monarch—for only then
can the peace of the Rose Kingdom be realized...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (... Come to think of it, there was a phrase Jordan and the others used when steeling their resolve.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It will soon be time for breakfast,
Lady Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...How long have you been standing there?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I was just on my way
to fetch you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I saw nothing at all.
Truly, not a single thing.
And thus, the summer training camp drew to a close.
